_about: Rules for Freeze / Heavy Stun / Electrocute / Pin buildup, which Path of Building does not model (it only has on/off config boxes). Draft from community sources (2026-11-22, task 29); every rule is unverified until a second source or patch notes agree. Edit numbers here, not in code.

freeze._note: Cold damage below the minimum to freeze adds to Freeze Buildup instead; a Freeze from filled buildup lasts 4 s by default.
freeze._source: Mobalytics freeze guide (https://mobalytics.gg/poe-2/guides/freeze); poe2.stratlore.com ailments guide

heavy_stun.builds_from: hit damage (physical and melee count more; cold doesn't build stun)
heavy_stun.against: enemy stun threshold (separate from the ailment threshold)
heavy_stun._note: Heavy Stun at 100% buildup; bigger monsters and map bosses have much higher stun thresholds. Buildup decays after ~8 s without stun damage (one source), rapidly after a Heavy Stun ends.

electrocute.builds_from: lightning damage of hits with an Electrocute source (supports, notables)

pin.builds_from: physical projectile hits with a Pin source (PoB: PinBuildupInsteadOfHeavyStunBuildup)
pin.against: enemy stun threshold (Pin uses the heavy stun bar's maths)
pin._source: PoB config tooltip ('Pinned enemies cannot move and cannot evade 4 seconds'); PoB CalcOffence (Pin buildup converted from heavy stun buildup)

bosses._note: Bosses have no full immunity: each time a boss is frozen, stunned or electrocuted, its threshold for that effect goes up (poe2source.com stagger guide). The size of the increase is not published: until it is, model one immobilise per fight phase as the cautious case.
